# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT_WITH_VOLUME_SPIKE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis
After a period of ATR-based volatility compression, a breakout accompanied by a volume surge signals institutional participation and continuation to the upside. The volatility contraction indicates reduced selling pressure and consolidation, while the volume-confirmed breakout suggests absorption of supply and initiation of new buying interest.

## Mechanism
Entry: If ATR(10) contracts to <= 0.8 * its 20-bar average for at least three consecutive bars (compression phase), and price breaks above the highest high of the prior 20 bars with volume > 1.5 * the average volume of those 20 bars, enter long at the close of the breakout bar.
Exit: Initial stop at the lowest low of the compression zone (chart-stop). Initial profit target at 2R (twice the risk from entry to stop). Upon hitting TP1, trail the remaining position with a chandelier exit (ATR*3) to capture extended moves. Additional filters: only active when VIX is between 15-25 and time is 11:00-14:00 ET; disabled when VIX < 12.
